## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Tech is the sole positive sector while 10 sectors are negative, and large-cap leadership is narrow with Top 5 skewed to Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND. Secondary leaders by relative performance (least weak): Energy with XOM (1W: -2.45% | 1M: +3.67%) CORRECTION and Communication with GOOGL (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -7.45%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND, DD (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -0.57%) BELOW TREND. Industrials and Financials lag: UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND, DD (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -0.57%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.93% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION, F (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +7.99%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND; note INTU has bearish news (-55) so price/sentiment diverge.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but technically positive: MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -7.45%) RECOVERY — Tech is the only sector positive (Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak overall: JPM (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth negative and no clear cyclical push.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names mixed with headline catalysts but price pressure 1W: JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.56% | 1M: +7.01%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND — bullish news exists but 1W weakness shows short-term dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Be selective and tactical given NEUTRAL regime and very thin breadth: favor names with confirmed ABOVE TREND momentum (SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to clear laggards in Materials and Industrials; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (only sector positive; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive) for concentration risk and follow-through. BEARISH: Materials and Industrials showing accelerating weakness (Materials 1W: -5.54%, Industrials 1W: -5.01%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) — sustained 1W momentum needed to keep ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) — failure to recover 1M losses keeps it BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) — watch for follow-through on small 1W advance to confirm continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+80): FDA approval headline; JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION — 1M confirms news but 1W weakness diverges. MA (+50): BofA reinstates coverage; MA (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -6.19%) BELOW TREND — bullish sentiment not yet reflected in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BLK (-50): negative headlines around fund flows; BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. INTU (-55): downgrade headline; INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND — clear sentiment/price divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style and no clear market leadership; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive and leadership narrow (4/5 Tech in Top 5). SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is extremely thin breadth and headline-driven divergences (INTU news divergence, Materials deterioration) — monitor for confirmation before adding exposure.
